title: Invoice totals with per-line half-up tax rounding
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag summing Decimals built from strings or the per-line tax total differing from tax computed on the subtotal. Both are the contract: Decimal strings avoid binary float error, and per-line half-up rounding is the stated rule, so the totals are exactly the sums of the rounded line values.
